themes.name: Critical Thinking in AI-Integrated Education
themes.definition: Development of cognitive skills including analysis, evaluation, and synthesis within AI-enabled learning environments, often measured through academic performance or self-assessment.
evidence: [Abdulayeva2025] 'The system fostered improved critical thinking... apply knowledge in interdisciplinary contexts.'
[Syahri2025] 'AI-supported PBL model... effective in enhancing the critical thinking abilities.'
[Argüelles-Álvarez2025] 'Students demonstrated the ability to differentiate quality in AI-assisted writing.'

themes.name: AI-Assisted Prompt and Feedback Systems
themes.definition: Use of generative AI to deliver personalized prompts, scaffolding, and formative feedback that influence learning trajectories.
evidence: [Singh2025a] 'Metacognitive prompts... support critical thinking during GenAI-based search.'
[Li2025e] 'RGPT provides personalized reflective prompts... promote deep learning.'
[Zhu2025] 'Oliver encourages exploration... compared to ChatGPT-4o mini.'

themes.name: Dual-Edged Impact of AI Tools
themes.definition: Recognition of AI's capacity to simultaneously enhance and hinder cognitive development, particularly in problem-solving and originality.
evidence: [Derakhshan2025] 'AI serves as a double-edged sword... fostering and impeding HOTS.'
[Balá2024] 'ChatGPT may detract from deep understanding... uniformity in solutions.'
[Chen2025d] 'Mitigate... overreliance on GenAI tools' (indirect evidence of duality)

themes.name: Design-Based Collaborative Learning
themes.definition: Integration of AI into project-based activities requiring teamwork, iterative refinement, and authentic problem-solving in technical domains.
evidence: [Chen2025d] 'Group assignment promotes challenge-based learning... using GenAI tools.'
[Singh2024] 'Student-AI collaborative feedback... fostering critical thinking about LLMs.'
[Rodomanchenko2024] 'Write business documents in teams... adaptation to organizational needs.'

themes.name: AI Literacy in Educational Contexts
themes.definition: Development of competencies to critically evaluate and effectively utilize AI tools within disciplinary practices.
evidence: [Tu2025] 'Cultivate students’ GenAI literacy and critical thinking skills.'
[Chen2025c] 'AI functioned as a catalyst... metacognitive operations.'

data.meta_observations: Three distinct clusters emerged: (1) Cognitive skill development focused on critical thinking metrics, (2) Technical integration patterns of AI scaffolding, and (3) Paradoxical outcomes of AI adoption. Uniquely, multiple studies addressed ethical considerations of AI use in collaborative settings.
data.grounding_notes: Some conclusions (e.g., Nawafleh2025) lacked quantitative evidence but contributed qualitative insights. Certain terms like 'problem-based learning' spanned multiple themes before consolidation into 'AI-supported PBL'. High consistency in terminology across engineering and liberal education contexts.
